name: Milton / Oakville
description: A former weekday Milton–Oakville Lakeshore connection, distinct from the old Hamilton route 22 and the route 22 introduced in 2024.

timeline.event: GO introduced a Milton–Bronte GO connection, an earlier corridor configuration.
Route 20 connects Milton GO with Oakville GO via Bronte Road / Highway 407 and Sheridan College.
The table also includes Trafalgar Road / Highway 407 and lists ten weekday trips each way.
Route 20 was withdrawn in the June changes.
